text:
The bilirubin level is mildly elevated and predominantly unconjugated, which is consistent with physiological or breast milk jaundice. The infant appears well, is feeding well, and the timeline fits typical physiological jaundice peaking around day 3-5. 

DIAGNOSIS READY: Physiological Jaundice
